question: Does a single previously screened, informative PIMPLE solver-path state improve source pretraining for low-resolution-to-high-resolution Navier-Stokes adaptation?

scope.method_claim: Solver-generated intermediate information may be learnable and useful; this study does not require Newton-path updates and makes no Newton-specific claim.
scope.equation: 2-D incompressible Navier-Stokes, Re=100, 20 backward-Euler physical steps, FV cavity flows.
scope.method_specific_access_policy: This pre-registration explicitly authorizes HR labels only for source-split source pretraining and source validation, and LR labels for target support and validation. It does not change NS-PIMPLE V0 training_access or its manifest.
scope.previously_exposed_task_exclusion: Exclude all HR and LR data from F4_poly24_top/a060 from this study because the earlier pilot opened its HR query trajectories.

source_training.label: canonical HR endpoint plus exactly the first complete non-endpoint PIMPLE outer correction at every physical step

source_validation.use: select source pretraining checkpoints by mean 20-step native HR rollout error

development_target.support: m=4 LR trajectories per task: V0 ic_a plus method-V1 support_s1/s2/s3
development_target.validation: four independent method-V1 validation_v1/v2/v3/v4 LR trajectories per task
development_target.query: four HR trajectories per task: V0 ic_b/ic_c plus method-V1 query_q1/q2; do not read before the global checkpoint/evaluator freeze

sealed_target.support: m=4 LR trajectories per task: V0 ic_a plus method-V1 support_s1/s2/s3
sealed_target.validation: four independent method-V1 validation_v1/v2/v3/v4 LR trajectories per task
sealed_target.query: four HR trajectories per task: V0 ic_b/ic_c plus method-V1 query_q1/q2; do not read before the global checkpoint/evaluator freeze

path_screen.frozen_rule: earliest complete non-endpoint PIMPLE outer state per physical step
path_screen.selection_gate: first-hook D1/S1 medians, D1 coverage, and second-half D1 thresholds from the V0 path gate; per-step maximization of both D and S is not required

arms.selected_pimple_path: HR source endpoint loss plus BL-RPNG correction loss on the first screened PIMPLE outer state, followed by final-only target NLT
arms.ordinary_final_only: matched HR source endpoint training without path supervision, followed by identical target NLT
arms.matched_endpoint_control: same path loss and norm as selected_pimple_path, but use endpoint direction with the first-path norm; followed by identical target NLT
arms.lifted_lr_scratch: random lifted FNO, trained on the same target LR support only; checkpoint selected on the same LR validation

training.model: 6-layer width-48 FNO, 16x16 modes, lifted cell-centred FV coordinates, velocity output (u,v)
training.source: AdamW lr=3e-4, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=2, maximum 60 epochs, minimum 30, patience 12, path-gradient ratio 0.05, path layer index 1
training.target_nlt: AdamW lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-6, batch=4, maximum 100 epochs, minimum 30, patience 12; final-only support objective
training.scratch: AdamW lr=3e-4, weight_decay=1e-4, batch=4, maximum 500 epochs, minimum 50, patience 25
training.validation_checkpoint_metric: mean 20-step LR rollout vector relative-L2 on the four independent target validation trajectories

evaluation.primary_metric: mean across 20 physical steps of ||U_pred-U_HR||_2/||U_HR||_2; report each query trajectory and task means
secondary_diagnostics: teacher-forced one-step relative-L2 to separate one-step approximation from autoregressive error accumulation
cell-centred finite-difference divergence RMS for prediction and reference (diagnostic only; not a conservative FV continuity metric)
evaluation.development: F5, two tasks, four HR query initial conditions per task
evaluation.confirmation: F6, two tasks, four HR query initial conditions per task
evaluation.freeze_order: Freeze all three source checkpoints, all F5/F6 target adapters, scratch checkpoints, evaluator code/config, and data-role manifest before reading any target HR query field.
evaluation.interpretation_rule: Solver-path learnability is supported only if selected_pimple_path beats both ordinary_final_only and matched_endpoint_control on development and confirmation means; otherwise report the corresponding negative result. Report lifted scratch separately.
evaluation.claim_limit: Only two target boundary families and four tasks are available. Treat the outcome as a focused validation, not broad statistical confirmation. No Newton-specific inference.
